at: Silla has now won this war!
alt: Chunchu on his feet over a flattened letter, grinning, while the councillors around the table keep their mourning faces.
scene: Night in Chunchu's house in Surabol. Worm's-eye from the table edge: the Tang letter smoothed flat under both his palms, one oil lamp on the table raking up into his face. Chunchu rising, mouth open mid-shout, delighted. Behind him in soft focus Yushin staring at the table and Alchun staring at Yushin, both in mourning white. Magenta lamplight catch on his silk.

alt: Chunchu's study at night, every wall pinned with Chang'an in pieces, Jukji reading the walls.
scene: Chunchu's private study, night. Low three-quarter from the floor among stacks of paper: walls and floor covered in pinned sheets, ward maps, a stele rubbing, a half-played go board under a latticed window. One lamp on the floor. Jukji standing mid-turn, reading a wall; Chunchu crouched over a stack in the foreground, out of focus.

at: like a scarecrow somebody has promoted
alt: Jukji in a Tang purple official robe with sleeves too long, arms out among the papers, Chunchu laughing.
scene: Same study. Jukji stands in the middle of the papers in a Tang purple official robe a size too big, sleeves past his hands, arms held out, bewildered. An open chest at his feet with green and scarlet robes folded in paper. Chunchu sits on a stack of the Tang code, laughing. Lamp on the floor between them, purple silk catching the light.

at: Then he raises his sleeve, first
alt: Alchun raising his sleeve first in a palace hall, the old councillors watching, a clerk writing by the door.
scene: A palace hall in Surabol, winter light through one door. Alchun in the tall first chair lifts one wide sleeve, face tired and amused. Five old councillors on low seats around him, ivory tablets in hand, one of them looking down at his own tablet. A young clerk kneels by the door with a brush. Long raking shadows across the floor.
